==============================

App name: RF-Scope

Target/compile SDK: 34 (Android 14)
Built at: 2026-11-08 (Asia/Shanghai)

Changes in 0.5.0:
- USB_DEVICE_ATTACHED filter for STM32 CDC VID 0x0483 / PID 0x5740.
- TinySA USB CDC serial transport and scanraw parser.
- 400-500 MHz / 200 point test spectrum with peak, noise floor and SNR.
- Wi-Fi 2.4/5/6 GHz channel occupancy charts.
- More visible WiFi row separators and chart grid lines.
- Relative time ticks in signal trend charts; missing samples break lines.
- Live header clock updates every second, with LAST update time.

Notes:
- Debug certificate; not suitable for Play Store publishing.
- Test spectrum range is currently fixed at 400-500 MHz.
